text: Exhibition Place employee recognized by the Board for outstanding accomplishments: 1. Annually Exhibition Place submits applications for appropriate venue and exhibition industry award programs to both recognize, promote and communicate the incredible achievements and success stories of Exhibition Place. The application process involves intense research to fulfil the submission requirements, gathering and development all of the material, while continuing to look for creative ways to promote and recognize Exhibition Place in both North America and internationally. Although multiple departments may contribute to providing information, it is through the ongoing efforts of one staff member, Jennifer Foster, Administrative Assistant to the General Manager, who researches and writes all award submissions. Over the past 4 years alone, Exhibition Place has been formally recognized with 11…

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Applauded and extended congratulations to Ms. Jennifer Foster for her outstanding efforts and dedication to continue to promote Exhibition Place in all award submissions.
